lines.text: The aquarium, after closing. Every tank glows blue. One of them is sparking.
Thank goodness. I'm Bo, night keeper. The animals have been... organizing.
The eel shorted the lights. The cuttlefish inked the gift shop. And Old Tess hasn't blinked in three days.
Eels zap if you dawdle. Ink hides your marks until you finish a line through it. Noted.
